players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.note: Jackson (high-ankle sprain) returned to practice Wednesday, Oct. 28 ahead of Week 8 at Buffalo, and CBS's Tracy Wolfson reported that coach Jesse Minter told her Jackson would play. He has missed three straight games and remains questionable until the final report.

players.name: Jalen Hurts
players.note: Hurts (IR, blood clots in his lungs) is expected to miss the rest of the 2026 season. Tanner McKee remains atop the Eagles' Week 8 depth chart, released Oct. 27.

players.name: Tanner McKee
players.note: The Eagles' Week 8 depth chart, released Oct. 27, still lists McKee as the starter ahead of Joe Milton and Cole Payton, despite a losing streak and speculation that Sirianni could make a change. He is a volatile superflex QB2.

players.name: Baker Mayfield
players.note: Mayfield is back as Tampa Bay's starter after returning from a dislocated thumb on Oct. 25 (7-of-11, 64 yards, 1 TD in a 43-13 win over Carolina). RotoBaller lists him among mid-week Week 8 waiver adds.

players.name: Jalon Daniels
players.note: Daniels went back to the backup role on Oct. 25 when Baker Mayfield returned from his thumb injury, which ended his three-game starting stint.

players.name: J.J. McCarthy
players.note: McCarthy went 20-of-28 for 252 yards, 0 TD and 0 INT in the Giants' 27-21 OT win at Houston on Oct. 25, and he is the starter with Jaxson Dart out for the season. The Giants are on bye in Week 8.

players.name: Jameis Winston
players.note: Winston is a backup and short-yardage option behind J.J. McCarthy after being benched in Week 6. He scored on a QB sneak on Oct. 25.

players.name: Jaxson Dart
players.note: Dart (IR) is out for the 2026 season after surgery to repair the meniscus and MCL in his left knee. J.J. McCarthy has the Giants' starting job.

players.name: Carson Beck
players.note: Beck (back) was limited at practice on Oct. 28 after missing time with back spasms, but coach Mike LaFleur says Jacoby Brissett is still the starter for Week 8 at Dallas. Beck has not been active on a game day this season.

players.name: Jacoby Brissett
players.note: LaFleur reaffirmed this week that Brissett is Arizona's starter despite a 2-5 start (about 1,600 yards, 10 TD and 6 INT in seven games), and he is a popular Week 8 streamer against Dallas. He threw for 272 yards and a TD on Oct. 25.

players.name: Kirk Cousins
players.note: Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said Oct. 26 that 'Kirk Cousins is our quarterback' and that there is no timeline for a Fernando Mendoza start. A four-game losing streak keeps the benching risk alive.

players.name: Fernando Mendoza
players.note: On Oct. 26 Kubiak committed to Kirk Cousins as the Raiders' starter, with no timeline for a Mendoza start, so the rookie's debut is on hold.

players.name: Aaron Jones Sr.
players.note: Jones (knee/MCL) did not practice Wednesday, Oct 28, ahead of Week 8 at Detroit after re-aggravating the injury on Oct 25. Jordan Mason would get more carries if Jones sits.

players.name: Jordan Mason
players.note: Mason led Minnesota with 15 carries for 68 yards on Oct 25. Aaron Jones (knee) did not practice Oct 28, so Mason could lead the backfield in Week 8 at Detroit.

players.name: Saquon Barkley
players.note: Barkley (hamstring/back) was listed as a non-participant on the Eagles' estimated report for Wednesday, Oct 28, when the team only held a walkthrough. He says he expects to play Sunday night at Washington, but he needs to practice at some point this week.

players.name: Jahmyr Gibbs
players.note: Gibbs did not practice Wednesday, Oct 28, because of a shoulder injury that had not been disclosed before, and it was not a rest day. Sione Vaki and Jacob Saylors would handle the work if he misses Week 8 vs. Minnesota.

players.name: Breece Hall
players.note: Hall (quad) was limited at practice Wednesday, Oct 28, which suggests he could return in Week 8 vs. Las Vegas after missing four straight games. Thursday and Friday practices will decide his status.

players.name: Braelon Allen
players.note: Allen was limited Wednesday, Oct 28, with a new ankle injury that is not believed to be serious, and Breece Hall (quad) was also limited. Allen ran for 104 yards on Oct 25, but his workload shrinks if Hall returns.

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.note: Love (high-ankle sprain) practiced on a limited basis Wednesday, Oct 28, after missing two games. That is a step toward returning Sunday at Dallas, but he likely needs to string together more practices.

players.name: Tyler Allgeier
players.note: Allgeier (toe) did not practice Wednesday, Oct 28, while Jeremiyah Love returned to practice on a limited basis. His Week 8 role at Dallas is in doubt.

players.name: Zonovan Knight
players.note: Knight led Arizona's backfield with a 53% snap share on Oct 25 and has a 49% snap share since Week 6. Jeremiyah Love was limited Oct 28 and Tyler Allgeier (toe) did not practice, and Mike LaFleur says Knight keeps a role either way.

players.name: Tyjae Spears
players.note: Spears (knee) did not practice Wednesday, Oct 28, after being inactive in Week 7. Tony Pollard remains Tennessee's primary back.

players.name: Kenny Gainwell
players.note: Gainwell (hip) did not practice Wednesday, Oct 28, ahead of Week 8 vs. Atlanta. He has not received a game designation yet.

players.name: Dylan Sampson
players.note: Sampson (knee) was limited at practice Wednesday, Oct 28. He played 47% of the snaps in Week 7 and is a PPR RB3 alongside Quinshon Judkins.

players.name: Kyle Monangai
players.note: Monangai (turf toe) did not practice Tuesday or Wednesday (Oct 27-28) and only did stationary bike work. He has missed Weeks 5-7 and looks unlikely to play in Week 8 at Seattle, though Chicago has not placed him on IR.

players.name: Zach Charbonnet
players.note: Charbonnet (ACL) was practicing on Wednesday, Oct 28, according to a Seahawks beat report. He could make his season debut Nov 2 vs. Chicago, but a heavy workload right away is unlikely.

players.name: Jadarian Price
players.note: Price was reported practicing on Wednesday, Oct 28, along with Zach Charbonnet. He remains on IR until Seattle activates him.

players.name: Emanuel Wilson
players.note: Wilson had 24 carries for 100 yards and a TD on Oct 25. Zach Charbonnet (ACL) was back at practice Oct 28, so Wilson's lead role may not last much longer.

players.name: Adam Randall
players.note: Baltimore designated Randall to return from IR on Oct 28, which opens a 21-day window to activate him. He had been on IR since the end of training camp.

players.name: Jonah Coleman
players.note: Coleman led Denver with 30 snaps (50% share), 9 carries for 54 yards and 2 catches for 15 yards in his Oct 25 return from IR. He is this week's top waiver add.

players.name: J.K. Dobbins
players.note: With Jonah Coleman back on Oct 25, Dobbins played only 14 snaps and had 6 carries for 23 yards and a 1-yard TD.

players.name: RJ Harvey
players.note: Harvey played only 16 snaps with 3 carries behind the returning Jonah Coleman on Oct 25, though he scored on a 52-yard screen pass.

players.name: Kaelon Black
players.note: Black had 12 carries for 63 yards and a TD on Oct 25 after Christian McCaffrey (hamstring) left the game. He is a popular contingency add during San Francisco's Week 8 bye.

players.name: Christian McCaffrey
players.note: Kyle Shanahan said on Oct 26 that McCaffrey has a mild hamstring strain and the team is 'pretty optimistic' he won't miss time, since SF has a Week 8 bye.

players.name: Rachaad White
players.note: White played a 68.7% snap share with a 41.2% rush share and a 14.7% target share in his last game. He is a widely recommended Week 8 waiver add while Jacory Croskey-Merritt is on IR.

players.name: Seth McGowan
players.note: McGowan played his biggest snap share of the season (34.5%) in Week 7 and is a deep waiver option in Indianapolis.

players.name: Ollie Gordon II
players.note: With De'Von Achane on IR, Gordon was clearly Miami's lead back on Oct 25 and played 42 of the team's first 52 offensive snaps.

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.note: Jacobs is not on Green Bay's final injury report for Thursday night vs. Carolina (Oct 29). He played a 54% snap share in his Week 7 return, and that share should grow.

players.name: Cam Skattebo
players.note: Skattebo had 17 carries for 124 yards on Oct 25, and Oct 26 reports call his hamstring tweak minor. He should be ready after the Week 8 bye for Nov 8 vs. the Eagles.

players.name: Tyrone Tracy Jr.
players.note: Tracy is on injured reserve with a hamstring injury as of Oct 27. Cam Skattebo leads the Giants backfield coming out of the Week 8 bye.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.note: Montgomery (groin) missed Weeks 6 and 7 and remains out. Houston is on bye in Week 8, which gives him extra time to heal.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.note: Marks led Houston's backfield again in Week 7 with David Montgomery (groin) out, but he is listed questionable (leg). Houston is on bye in Week 8.

players.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
players.note: Robinson (hamstring) missed Week 7 and is listed questionable as of Oct 28. Bijan Robinson had 20 carries for 63 yards and 5 catches for 59 yards without him.

players.name: Dameon Pierce
players.note: Pierce was placed on injured reserve (undisclosed injury) on Oct 28.

players.name: Jaylen Waddle
players.note: Waddle did not practice Wednesday (Oct 28) after reinjuring the chest he hurt late in the Oct 25 win over Arizona, where he had 4-48 on 7 targets. His status for Nov 1 against Kansas City is in real doubt.

players.name: Carnell Tate
players.note: Tate did not practice Wednesday (Oct 28) with a shoulder injury. Thursday and Friday participation will decide his Week 8 status.

players.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
players.note: He was listed as a non-participant Wednesday (Oct 28) with an ankle injury. One report calls it a shoulder, and it does not appear to be a serious concern so far.

players.name: Ja'Marr Chase
players.note: He did not practice Wednesday (Oct 28), listed as a veteran rest day with an ankle injury. Reports do not believe he is in danger of missing Week 8.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.note: Thompson was a DNP on the Chargers' first Week 8 injury report (Wed, Oct 28) with a quadriceps/hamstring injury, which puts his availability in question.

players.name: Emeka Egbuka
players.note: Egbuka (concussion, foot) got in a limited practice Wednesday (Oct 28) ahead of Week 8 against Atlanta. He still has to clear the concussion protocol.

players.name: Jalen Coker
players.note: Coker (shoulder) went from limited Monday to full practice Tuesday (Oct 27) and is trending toward playing Thursday night at Green Bay. He has led Carolina with a 25.7% target share in his three full games.

players.name: Christian Watson
players.note: Matthew Golden's status for TNF on Oct 29 is unclear; reports conflict on whether he practiced Wednesday. If Golden sits, Green Bay's passing game should funnel through Watson and Tucker Kraft.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.note: Smith missed Week 7 with a hamstring injury that dates to camp. As of Oct 27 Philadelphia had given no timeline and would not rule out IR, and one outlet projects him out until after the Week 10 bye.

players.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
players.note: Samuel has missed two straight games with a hamstring injury, including Oct 25 at Atlanta. San Francisco is on bye in Week 8, and he is targeting a Week 9 return.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.note: Adams remains on IR with a ruptured hamstring (semitendinosus), and Sean McVay has given a 6-10 week timeline.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.note: Pierce remains on IR with a heel injury. Shane Steichen said his practice window is 'most likely not' opening in Week 8.

players.name: Antonio Williams
players.note: With Terry McLaurin out for the season (torn patellar tendon), Williams projects as Washington's WR2 behind Stefon Diggs starting Nov 1 against Philadelphia.

players.name: Germie Bernard
players.note: Bernard had 3-27 on 5 targets in the Oct 25 win over New Orleans, his third straight game with at least 5 targets. He remains Pittsburgh's WR2 while Michael Pittman Jr. is on IR.

players.name: DeMario Douglas
players.note: With Romeo Doubs and Mack Hollins on IR, Douglas remains one of New England's top targets next to A.J. Brown.

players.name: Caleb Douglas
players.note: Douglas returned from his ankle injury on Oct 25, played 68% of the snaps, ran a route on 81% of dropbacks and scored a 63-yard TD in the 28-25 win over the Jets. He drew only 3 targets.

players.name: Chris Bell
players.note: Caleb Douglas's return in the Oct 25 win over the Jets pushed Bell back to Miami's WR3 role, which shrinks his weekly floor.

players.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
players.note: Lane ran more routes and drew more targets than Rashod Bateman in Week 7 and is working as Baltimore's WR2 opposite Zay Flowers. Lamar Jackson is reportedly set to return Nov 1 against Buffalo.

players.name: Devaughn Vele
players.note: Vele led the Saints' receivers with a 92% snap share in Week 7, compared with 58% for Chris Olave, and has drawn at least six targets in every game this season.

players.name: Elijah Sarratt
players.note: Sarratt was a healthy scratch for Baltimore's 35-13 loss to Cincinnati on Oct 25. Ja'Kobi Lane is ahead of him for the WR2 role.

players.name: Jameson Williams
players.note: Williams scored two TDs on 9 targets for a season-high 26.1 fantasy points in Detroit's Oct 25 win over Green Bay. Amon-Ra St. Brown's Wednesday DNP (ankle) could push more volume his way.

players.name: Garrett Wilson
players.note: Wilson has only 9 targets over the last two games, including the Oct 25 loss at Miami. Rookie Omar Cooper Jr. has topped 100 yards in back-to-back games and Breece Hall is nearing a return.

players.name: DJ Moore
players.note: Moore has been out since Oct 18 with an AC joint shoulder injury and is listed questionable. Buffalo is coming off its Week 7 bye, and this week's practice reports will decide whether he plays Nov 1 against Baltimore.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.note: Sleeper listed Brown questionable (ankle) on Oct 28. It is the same right ankle that put him on IR earlier this season, so watch his Thursday and Friday practice reports.

players.name: Jakobi Meyers
players.note: Sleeper listed Meyers questionable (hamstring) on Oct 28. No Week 8 practice detail had surfaced yet.

players.name: George Pickens
players.note: Sleeper listed Pickens questionable (shoulder) on Oct 28. He has been managing the shoulder for weeks and played through it in Week 7.

players.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
players.note: Harrison played just 13 snaps and had 1 catch for 6 yards in Houston's Oct 25 OT loss to the Giants. Houston has a Week 8 bye.

players.name: Keenan Allen
players.note: Allen played just 30 snaps in the Oct 25 loss at Minnesota, behind Josh Downs (52) and Laquon Treadwell (45). He still led the Colts with 3 catches for 31 yards.

players.name: Kendrick Bourne
players.note: With Jalen Brooks out for the season and Marvin Harrison Jr. traded, Bourne is Arizona's No. 2 WR behind Michael Wilson. He has 22 targets over the last three games, a span that includes the Oct 25 loss to Denver.

players.name: Xavier Worthy
players.note: Worthy caught 3 of 6 targets for 11 yards on 46 snaps in the 20-3 loss at Seattle on Oct 25. KC's WRs combined for 39 yards on 13 targets with Rashee Rice out.

players.name: Zay Flowers
players.note: Flowers had 8 catches for 137 yards and a TD on 57 snaps in the 35-13 loss to Cincinnati on Oct 25, even with Tyler Huntley at QB.

players.name: Luther Burden III
players.note: Burden played 61% of the snaps in the Oct 22 TNF win, nearly double his Week 6 share, and led Chicago with 4 catches for 130 yards and a TD.

players.name: Rome Odunze
players.note: Odunze had 4 catches for 69 yards on Oct 22, and Luther Burden outproduced him for the second straight week.

players.name: Tee Higgins
players.note: Higgins had 6 catches for 148 yards and a TD in the 35-13 win at Baltimore on Oct 25, outproducing Ja'Marr Chase (5-62-1).

players.name: Malik Nabers
players.note: Nabers had 7 catches for 111 yards in the Oct 25 OT win at Houston, J.J. McCarthy's first start. The Giants are on bye in Week 8.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.note: Evans (ribs/Achilles) missed the Oct 25 loss at Atlanta, and the 49ers have a Week 8 bye, so Week 9 is his earliest possible return.

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.note: Doubs (shoulder) has been on IR since Oct 19 and is out at least through Week 10.

players.name: Jordyn Tyson
players.note: Tyson (hamstring) remains on IR, and reports point to a Week 9 return after the Saints' Week 8 bye.

players.name: Makai Lemon
players.note: Lemon had 7 catches for 67 yards and his first career TD in the Oct 26 MNF loss to Dallas. He led the Eagles in receiving with DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks out.

players.name: Tyreek Hill
players.note: Hill (recovering from a torn ACL) was still an unsigned free agent as of the latest reports. Drew Rosenhaus said on Oct 13 that a deal 'could happen anytime,' and the Chiefs are among the interested teams.

players.name: Stefon Diggs
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (hand) as of 4:46 PM PT Oct 28. Earlier: Diggs (24-214-4 in five games) is Washington's de facto WR1 coming off the Week 7 bye. Terry McLaurin tore his patellar tendon on Oct 19.

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.note: Sleeper now lists him on injured reserve (knee) as of 10:00 AM PT Oct 28. Earlier: McLaurin tore his left patellar tendon on Oct 19 and is out for the 2026 season.

players.name: Rashid Shaheed
players.note: Shaheed (knee) is listed questionable as of Oct 28 after colliding with Jaxon Smith-Njigba on Oct 25 (2 catches, 1 yard). Mike Macdonald said on Oct 26 that early returns were positive, ahead of next Monday's game vs. Chicago.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.note: McConkey (concussion) practiced in a non-contact jersey on Oct 26 and is listed questionable as of Oct 28. He still has to clear the protocol before Week 8 vs. the Rams.

players.name: Matthew Golden
players.note: Golden (shoulder/foot) was upgraded to limited on the Packers' Oct 28 report after two DNPs and is officially questionable for tonight's TNF game vs. Carolina.

players.name: Rashee Rice
players.note: Rice (hamstring/knee) was listed as a limited participant on Kansas City's Oct 28 practice report, his first practice action since getting hurt in Week 4. That puts a Week 8 return vs. Denver in play.

players.name: Tre' Harris
players.note: Harris (hamstring) returned to practice as a limited participant on Oct 28, his first practice since a Week 5 injury, ahead of Week 8 vs. the Rams.

players.name: Michael Wilson
players.note: Wilson (ribs) was a limited participant in practice on Oct 28 and is listed questionable for Week 8.

players.name: Malik Washington
players.note: Washington (knee) was limited at Miami's Oct 28 practice and is listed questionable for Week 8.

players.name: Josh Downs
players.note: WR-needy teams were calling the Colts about Downs as of Oct 27 (per Jordan Schultz), and a Yahoo live blog says he has reportedly requested a trade, with Indy selling ahead of the Nov 10 deadline. He's in the final year of his rookie deal, so his landing spot could change his role.

players.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
players.note: Rookie Cooper had another big game in Week 7 and was a top waiver add heading into Week 8 (RotoBaller, SportsLine). He looks like the Jets' ascending receiver.

players.name: Tank Dell
players.note: Dell played 14 snaps in his Oct 25 return, one more than Marvin Harrison Jr., and his first catch went for 43 yards. Jaylin Noel (turf toe) was still being evaluated on Oct 26, and Houston has a Week 8 bye.

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.note: Bowers (calf) was limited in Wednesday's practice on Oct 28, the first Week 8 report. The hamstring listed alongside it in Week 7 seems to be behind him.

players.name: Dalton Kincaid
players.note: Kincaid was limited on Oct 28 in Buffalo's first practice after its bye, wearing a no-contact jersey. The injury is now listed as chest instead of ribs.

players.name: Tyler Warren
players.note: Warren (groin) was listed as limited on Oct 28, but the Colts only held a walkthrough, so that is an estimate. He has missed the last two games and is still very questionable for Week 8.

players.name: Terrance Ferguson
players.note: Ferguson (ankle) can come off IR starting in Week 8, but Sean McVay said on Oct 26 that the Rams hadn't decided whether he would practice this week.

players.name: Colston Loveland
players.note: With Cole Kmet (knee) out for the season, Loveland drew 12 targets and went 7-69-1 in Week 7. Chicago plays at Seattle on Monday night, Nov 2.

players.name: Hunter Henry
players.note: Henry went 4-48-1 on five targets in Week 7, his second straight game with a TD. RotoBaller (Oct 27) has him as the TE9 through six games and named him the top Week 8 TE pickup.

players.name: Chig Okonkwo
players.note: With Terry McLaurin reportedly done for the season, Okonkwo caught 11 of 13 targets for 129 yards over the two games before Washington's bye. He is a top waiver TE ahead of hosting the Eagles on Nov 1.

players.name: Mike Gesicki
players.note: The Bengals put Erick All Jr. on IR on Oct 27 with a feared torn ACL. That leaves Gesicki as the clear lead pass-catching TE, though rookie Jack Endries should also see more work.

players.name: Brenton Strange
players.note: RotoBaller listed Strange as the only must-add TE on Week 8 waivers (Oct 27). He is about 46% rostered.

players.name: T.J. Hockenson
players.note: Hockenson went 4-35-1 in Week 7 and is a waiver option ahead of his Week 8 revenge game at Detroit.

players.name: Isaiah Likely
players.note: Likely leads all TEs in PPR points but suffered a concussion. The Athletic's Dan Duggan reported Oct 27 that he should be fine after the Giants' Week 8 bye.

players.name: Kenyon Sadiq
players.note: Mason Taylor scored two TDs in Week 7 and has moved ahead of the rookie on the Jets' TE depth chart (RotoBaller, Oct 26).

players.name: Juwan Johnson
players.note: New Orleans has moved to a three-man TE rotation (PFF, Oct 25), which cuts into Johnson's role, and the Saints are on bye in Week 8.
